title: Canada Tariffs Escalate Trade Spat; Markets brace for Inflation Test
description:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on "Bloomberg Open Interest." The summer calm may be over. Middle East tensions hit markets ahead of a crucial inflation report, as the US-Canada trade fight escalates. Apple enters the John Ternus era with a foldable iPhone. Plus, NASCAR CEO Steve O’Donnell on racing’s momentum, Bloomberg Intelligence’s Mandeep Singh on Qualcomm’s Amazon chip deal, and Julie Macklowe on tariffs, whiskey and the rise of ready-made cocktails.
